### what_to_do_first.details[0]
Sentence: Given Helsinki's 0.1% (95% CI 0.0–0.4; n=1/1486) crude recorded MDT share, 29.1% (95% CI 26.8–31.4; n=432/1486) crude no-treatment-record share, ~48% missing stage nationally, and incomplete national data collection, the team recommends publishing county recording completeness for stage, drug treatment, and MDT coding while the roadmap plans a national quality registry targeting 90% coverage.
Cited claims:
  [rec:3] status=recommendation (ours) | source: docs/recommendations.md, §3. Report recording completeness per county: stage, drug treatment, MDT coding | Team recommendation 3: Report recording completeness per county: stage, drug treatment, MDT coding. Publish, per county, how completely stage, drug treatment and MDT meetings are recorded. Read county ‘gaps’ in these fields as data-quality signals first. | notes: the team's own DRAFT recommendation, not yet reviewed by mentors; not evidence. Its evidence is listed under it in docs/recommendations.md and must be cited separately
  [cty:mdt_recorded:Helsingin_kaupunki] status=verified locally | source: Finnish Cancer Registry report Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023, Taulukko 11 | Helsingin kaupunki: MDT meeting recorded 0.1% (95% CI 0.0–0.4; n=1/1486), below vs national 6.0% | notes: level=county; n=1; total=1486; ci_low=0.01; ci_high=0.38; national_share=6.0042; vs_national=below; share = n/total as printed; Wilson 95% CI computed by src/add_ci.py; crude, not age- or stage-adjusted; categories overlap
  [cty:no_treatment_record:Helsingin_kaupunki] status=verified locally | source: Finnish Cancer Registry report Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023, Taulukko 11 | Helsingin kaupunki: no treatment record within 12 months 29.1% (95% CI 26.8–31.4; n=432/1486), not distinguishable vs national 27.5% | notes: level=county; n=432; total=1486; ci_low=26.82; ci_high=31.43; national_share=27.4928; vs_national=not distinguishable; share = n/total as printed; Wilson 95% CI computed by src/add_ci.py; crude, not age- or stage-adjusted; categories overlap
  [bs:coverage:Diagnosis] status=verified locally | source: Finnish Cancer Registry report Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2019–2023, §4.1, Taulukko 2–4, Kuva 5–13 | Pathway stage 'Diagnosis' is measured in public data: yes (by county: yes (Kuva 7, 10, 13: PNG only)) | notes: Registry diagnosis date, diagnosis basis, histology. Stage is a blind spot within it: “levinneisyys toteamishetkellä puuttuu lähes puolelta uusia potilaita” (§4.1.3, ~48%), so curative shares cannot be stage-adjusted.
  [q:950a2f797b] status=verified locally | source: Filha National Lung Cancer Programme 2026–2035, p.21 | Reporting, collection and storage of lung cancer data is currently incomplete. | notes: cited in docs/recommendations.md, docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): Tällä hetkellä keuhkosyöpään liittyvien tietojen raportointi, kerääminen ja tallentaminen on puutteellista. | translation: Currently, the reporting, collection and storage of data related to lung cancer are deficient.
  [q:f07a34a300] status=verified locally | source: Cancer strategy implementation roadmap 2026–2031 (STM), p.59 | A national cancer care quality registry will be set up alongside THL's Cancer Registry. | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): Perustetaan THL:n Syöpärekisterin yhteyteen kansallinen syövän hoidon laaturekisteri. | translation: A national cancer care quality register is established in connection with THL's Cancer Registry.
  [q:4a856bd695] status=verified locally | source: Cancer strategy implementation roadmap 2026–2031 (STM), p.60 | the registry's data, including stage, allows reliable assessment and comparison of quality and effectiveness, with 90% data coverage | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): Laaturekisterin tietopohja (ml. levinneisyystieto) mahdollistaa laadun ja vaikuttavuuden luotettavan arvioinnin ja vertailun (tietopohjan kattavuus 90 %) | translation: The quality register's data base (incl. stage information) enables reliable evaluation and comparison of quality and effectiveness (data base coverage 90%)

### what_to_do_first.details[1]
Sentence: Because Health Care Act §52 sets no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion, the roadmap plans national pathway descriptions and target access times by 2026–2028, and the Filha diagnostics guideline is due before the 2030 mid-term evaluation, the team recommends reporting access times using THL Ohjaus 21/2016 definitions (for 16 cancers) with handover alerts.
Cited claims:
  [rec:1] status=recommendation (ours) | source: docs/recommendations.md, §1. Counties report access times using the THL 21/2016 definitions, with handover alerts | Team recommendation 1: Counties report access times using the THL 21/2016 definitions, with handover alerts. Each wellbeing services county reports lung cancer access times (referral → first specialist visit → diagnosis → treatment start) using the definitions in THL's Hoitoonpääsyn seuranta syövän hoidossa (Ohjaus 21/2016). Until national target times exist, flag stalled handovers. | notes: the team's own DRAFT recommendation, not yet reviewed by mentors; not evidence. Its evidence is listed under it in docs/recommendations.md and must be cited separately
  [law:no_max] status=verified by Hellu | source: teammate Hellu's background brief, 5. What the law guarantees (Health Care Act, §52) | There is no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion | notes: scope: national law; applies to every county; Health Care Act §52 and Valvira statement, read by Hellu | quote (en): there is no legal maximum time for a cancer suspicion
  [thl:21_2016] status=verified by Hellu | source: teammate Hellu's background brief, 6. Regional pathways compared | THL Ohjaus 21/2016 defines how cancer access times are recorded, for 16 cancers | notes: scope: definitions only; says nothing about whether counties use or report them; in force since 1 Jan 2017; THL document not in data/raw | quote (en): defined how cancer access times are recorded for 16 cancers, so that they could be reported nationally
  [q:def306014c] status=verified locally | source: Cancer strategy implementation roadmap 2026–2031 (STM), p.57 | p.57, timetable: > “2026–2028: Kansalliset hoitoketjukuvaukset tehty viidestä syövästä ja syöpäkohtaiset > hoitoonpääsyajat on määritetty.” | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): 2026–2028: Kansalliset hoitoketjukuvaukset tehty viidestä syövästä ja syöpäkohtaiset hoitoonpääsyajat on määritetty. | translation: 2026–2028: National care pathway descriptions completed for five cancers and cancer-specific access-to-care times have been defined.
  [q:8f358a9de6] status=verified locally | source: Filha National Lung Cancer Programme 2026–2035, p.16 | p.16: > “Tämän ohjelman yhtenä toimenpiteenä tuotetaan kansallinen suositus keuhkosyöpien diagnostiikasta. Se > sisältää myös lähetekriteerit perusterveydenhuollolle ja suositellut aikarajat erikoissairaanhoitoon > eri diagnostiikan polun vaiheille.” | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): Tämän ohjelman yhtenä toimenpiteenä tuotetaan kansallinen suositus keuhkosyöpien diagnostiikasta. Se sisältää myös lähetekriteerit perusterveydenhuollolle ja suositellut aikarajat erikoissairaanhoitoon eri diagnostiikan polun vaiheille. | translation: As one measure of this programme, a national guideline on the diagnostics of lung cancers will be produced. It also includes referral criteria for primary health care and recommended time limits for specialised medical care for the different stages of the diagnostic pathway.
  [q:614febebf2] status=verified locally | source: Filha National Lung Cancer Programme 2026–2035, p.24 | When (p.24): > “Väliarvio toteutetaan vuonna 2030, ohjelman puolivälissä ja loppuarviointi vuonna 2036. Eri > osa-alueiden suositukset toteutetaan ennen väliarviointia.” | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): Väliarvio toteutetaan vuonna 2030, ohjelman puolivälissä ja loppuarviointi vuonna 2036. Eri osa-alueiden suositukset toteutetaan ennen väliarviointia. | translation: The interim evaluation will be carried out in 2030, halfway through the programme, and the final evaluation in 2036. Guidelines for the different sub-areas will be implemented before the interim evaluation.

### what_to_do_first.details[2]
Sentence: Since referrals follow local instructions and mentor insight notes weak referrals receive lower specialist urgency ratings, the team recommends a standard referral template, referring persistent symptoms after a normal X-ray to a pulmonologist, and naming a diagnostic-phase contact, while the roadmap plans standardised referral criteria and care-coordinator guidance by 2026–2028 (for county adoption by 2029–2031).
Cited claims:
  [rec:2] status=recommendation (ours) | source: docs/recommendations.md, §2. A KYS-style referral template, a persistent-symptoms rule and a named contact | Team recommendation 2: A KYS-style referral template, a persistent-symptoms rule and a named contact. Adopt a standard referral content list and template, modelled on KYS. • Add a rule for primary care: if symptoms persist after a normal X-ray, refer for a pulmonologist assessment. • Name a contact person for the diagnostic phase, from referral to diagnosis. | notes: the team's own DRAFT recommendation, not yet reviewed by mentors; not evidence. Its evidence is listed under it in docs/recommendations.md and must be cited separately
  [q:556431a0c2] status=verified locally | source: Filha National Lung Cancer Programme 2026–2035, p.15 | the patient is referred to specialist care according to local instructions | notes: cited in docs/recommendations.md, docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): potilas lähetetään jatkotutkimuksiin erikoissairaanhoidon yksikköön omien paikallisten ohjeistusten mukaisesti | translation: the patient is referred for further examinations to a specialised medical care unit in accordance with their own local guidelines
  [mentor:kaisa_referral] status=mentor insight | source: teammate Hellu's background brief, 7. Where patients get stuck | A weak referral gets a lower urgency rating in specialist care | notes: scope: general expert view; not county-specific and not from a written source; Kaisa; no written source | quote (en): A weak referral gets a lower urgency rating in specialist care.
  [q:9a1cd194f5] status=verified locally | source: Cancer strategy implementation roadmap 2026–2031 (STM), p.52 | support a smooth transfer to specialist care by defining standardised referral criteria within the national pathways, so that patients with possible cancer symptoms who meet them are directed quickly to diagnostic tests | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): Tuetaan sujuvaa siirtymää erikoissairaanhoitoon määrittämällä kansallisiin hoitoketjuihin kuuluvat standardoidut lähetekriteerit, joiden täyttyessä mahdollisista syöpäoireista kärsivät potilaat ohjataan nopeasti tarvittaviin diagnostisiin tutkimuksiin | translation: Support a smooth transition to specialised medical care by defining standardised referral criteria included in national care pathways, upon the fulfilment of which patients suffering from possible cancer symptoms are rapidly referred to the necessary diagnostic examinations
  [q:c61439b30f] status=verified locally | source: Cancer strategy implementation roadmap 2026–2031 (STM), p.53 | 2026–2028: standardised referral criteria and symptom-based models included in the national pathways of at least the five most common cancers. | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): 2026–2028: Standardoidut lähetekriteerit ja oirelähtöiset toimintamallit sisällytetty vähintään viiden yleisimmän syövän kansallisiin hoitoketjukuvauksiin. | translation: 2026–2028: Standardised referral criteria and symptom-based operating models included in the national care pathway descriptions of at least the five most common cancers.
  [q:abcbb06ae3] status=verified locally | source: Cancer strategy implementation roadmap 2026–2031 (STM), p.32 | 2026–2028: guidance on a named doctor, nurse or specialist worker coordinating cancer care. 2029–2031: wellbeing services counties have adopted it. | notes: cited in docs/source_verification.md | quote (fi): 2026–2028: Ohjeistus syövän hoidon koordinaatiosta vastaavan nimetyn lääkärin, hoitajan tai erityistyöntekijän mallista. 2029–2031: Hyvinvointialueet ovat ottaneet tämän ohjeistuksen käyttöön. | translation: 2026–2028: Guidelines on the model of a designated physician, nurse or special worker responsible for coordinating cancer care. 2029–2031: Wellbeing services counties have adopted these guidelines.
  [q:050ee09ebe] status=verified locally | source: Cancer strategy implementation roadmap 2026–2031 (STM), p.32 | Guidance on a named worker coordinating cancer care by 2026–2028, adopted by counties by 2029–2031; the care phase is left open (“missä hoidon vaiheessa … olisi tärkeintä kohdentaa”) | notes: cited in docs/recommendations.md | quote (fi): missä hoidon vaiheessa … olisi tärkeintä kohdentaa | translation: at which stage of care … it would be most important to target

flags.sentence: Diagnosis counts are well supported, but crude county treatment shares lack age or stage adjustment, and public registry data do not capture pathway dates or pre-specialist care.
flags.problem: Overreaches and partly contradicts the cited claims: bs:coverage:Diagnosis explicitly states that the registry records the diagnosis date ('Registry diagnosis date'), so saying public registry data do not capture 'pathway dates' is inaccurate; additionally, bs:coverage:Primary_care_occupational_health states that primary care visits are not included in the report's data and occupational health is not mentioned in the report (rather than claiming that no public registry data capture pre-specialist care).

flags.sentence: County treatment shares are crude and not adjusted for age or stage: stage at diagnosis is missing for ~48% of new patients, and while Kuva 16 provides digitised national age-adjusted curative shares of 26.7% for men and 26.9% for women (read off a figure, precision ±0.5 percentage points), no age-adjusted county value is provided.
flags.problem: None of the cited claims support the statement that 'no age-adjusted county value is provided'; k16:curative:men:national and k16:curative:women:national only report the digitised national reference lines from Kuva 16 and say nothing about whether age-adjusted county values are provided.
